latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AssetFlow – an automated digital asset management workflow skill.

- Automates organization, storage, and metadata tagging of digital assets across multiple cloud and DAM platforms.
- Supports AWS S3, Google Drive, Azure Blob Storage, Dropbox, Box, and native DAM providers.
- Includes intelligent asset sorting, batch tagging, version tracking, compliance, and approval workflows.
- Integrates with Slack for notifications and Google Sheets for updates.
- Configurable asset taxonomies, retention policies, and metadata templates.
- Provides example prompts and setup instructions for quick onboarding.
